install_output_empty: Hapasati yabuda. Terminal mitsara kubva pachigadziro chekuisa ichaonekwa pano.
linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kurodha uye kugadzirisa iyo yakakwirira-inomhanya inopenya injini kuti iwe ugone kudzoreredza uye kugadzirisa mutambi wako zvisina basa.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek yemuno inopenya chishandiso ine universal raibhurari inoenderana yakaiswa.
linux_card_usb_desc: Inopa desktop mvumo yekutaurirana nemutambi muBootloader mode.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Yakakwana ongororo yevatyairi, kernel modules, mvumo, uye runtime maraibhurari kuti ave nechokwadi chekupenya kwakavimbika.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Inoita kuti komputa yako igadzirire kubatana kune mutambi wako kuti agadzirise software.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Inotarisa iyo yepamusoro Linux setup yeSP Flash Tool, USB kupinda, serial mvumo, uye system zvikamu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Inoita kuti komputa yako igadzirire kubatana kune mutambi wako uye nekuisa zvigadziriso zvesoftware zvakavimbika.
settings_checker_desc: Inoita kuti komputa yako igadzirire kubatana kune mutambi wako uye nekuisa zvigadziriso zvesoftware zvakavimbika.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Komputa yako yakagadzirira kubatana nemutambi wako.
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Unogona kubatanidza mutambi wako kana wabvunzwa.
linux_prep_blocked: Komputa iyi haigone kushandisa SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Pasiwedhi yako inodiwa kamwe chete kumisikidza komputa iyi yekupenya: iyo USB mitemo yeMediaTek zvishandiso uye serial port yekupinda.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kumisikidza komputa iyi yeSP Flash Tool, password yako inozodiwa mudanho rinotevera kugadzirisa mitemo yeUSB uye kuwedzera account yako kumapoka evashandisi anodiwa. Kana ukaramba, application yacho inovhara.
linux_prep_fixed: Kuwana kwabvumidzwa, SP Flash Tool yakagadzirira.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kuseta kwapera uye account yako yawedzerwa kumapoka evashandisi anodiwa eSP Flash Tool. Ndokumbira utangezve komputa yako kuti mvumo mitsva iite, wobva wavhura iyo app zvakare. Dzvanya cheki kuti uvhare app izvozvi.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Wapedza, Vhara App kuti utangezve Kombuta
settings_driver_desc: Usati washandisa app kekutanga, unofanira kuisa MediaTek USB mutyairi, wobva watangazve komputa yako.
home_desc: Tsvaga firmware pamhepo kana sarudza pasuru yemuno, wobva wavheneka kune chako kifaa.
sel_source_desc: Dhawunirodha firmware online, kana pinza pasuru yemuno.
settings_advanced_desc: Inoratidza nzira yekuisa, yekuisa modhi uye kuburitsa mafirita.
settings_guided_install_desc: Iyo app inogara newe kuburikidza nekudzima, kubatanidza, uye kuisa.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Inovhara Kuwedzeredza CE uye inovhura SP Flash Tool GUI ine yakasarudzwa firmware paradzira faira uye yekugovera mifananidzo yakafanorongedzerwa.
settings_terminal_desc: Inomhanyisa kuisirwa kwesoftware yako muTerminal kuti iwe ugone kuona ruzivo rwehunyanzvi pakufambira mberi.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Inomhanyisa kuisirwa kwesoftware yako muCommand Prompt kuti iwe ugone kuona ruzivo rwehunyanzvi pakufambira mberi.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Optional. Zvimwe zvinangwa zveMediaTek zvinoramba kupenya kusvika SP Flash Tool yapihwa faira rechokwadi (.auth); wedzera yako pano kana mudziyo uchida imwe.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Hapana faira rekuparadzira rakawanikwa mupakeji iyi, saka hapana murairo wekoni unogona kuvakwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Hapana SP Flash Tool kuvaka kana MTKClient yekupinda nzvimbo inowanikwa kune iyi nzira.
terminal_install_failed: Hatina kukwanisa kuvhura hwindo rechiteshi. Murairo wekuisa wakanyorwa ku {path}.
status_terminal_install: Isa murairo wakavhurwa muhwindo rako rekupedzisira ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ikozvino ichavhura ichimhanya {method}.

• Kana isati yatodzima, dzima {device} yako.
• Kana yakabatana neUSB, bvisa iyo kutanga.
{hint}
• Batanidza mudziyo wako pakombuta yako kana {terminal_name} hwindo ravhurwa.

Dzvanya OK kuti utange uye kubuda Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Zano: Kana mudziyo ukasabatana woga, tinya zvinyoro nyoro bhatani reseta paburi repini nepaperclip paunenge uchibatanidza tambo ye USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Zano: Isa mudziyo wako mufirmware yekudhawunirodha modhi (inosiyana nemhando: semuenzaniso bvisa bhatiri worichengeta usina USB tambo yakabatana, kana kudzima nebhatiri mukati, kana kubata Volume Down/Kumusoro paunenge uchibatanidza USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Isa kuburikidza neSP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI ikozvino ichavhura neyako firmware preloaded.

• MuSP Flash Tool, sarudza "Download" kubva mubhokisi rekudonhedza.
• Dzvanya bhatani re "Download".
• Ita shuwa kuti {device} yako yakadzimwa uye yakabviswa.
{hint}
• Batanidza USB tambo kuti kombiyuta yako pashure nekudzvanya Download.

Dzvanya OK kuvhura SP Flash Tool uye kubuda Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Kana yagoneswa, Rockbox themes anoendeswa otomatiki kuY1 mushure mekubudirira kweRockbox kuisirwa.
themes_placement_failed_note: Hatina kukwanisa kuisa matheme pack pamutambi wako. Unogona kuedza zvakare kubva kuSettings.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Ratidza Yekutanga Software inoburitsa yakare pane 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Yekutanga Software inoburitswa yakura kupfuura 3.0.7 haienderane neY1 mayunitsi anotengeswa neInnioasis OS 3.0.7. Kuvheneka chivakwa chekare pane aya mayunitsi kuchavadzivirira kubva pakubhomba kudzamara shanduro itsva yadzorerwa.

Une chokwadi chekuti unoda kuratidza Yekutanga Software kuburitswa kwekare pane 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Ratidza anovaka ane ROM zip iri 240p musiyano (rom…_240p.zip). 240p inovaka haienderane neY1 mauniti paInnioasis OS pazasi 3.0.7, saka Ratidza Old Rockbox Inovaka inogoneswa nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Yakaburitswa yeRockbox-Y1 isati yasvika 0.5 haienderane neY1 mayunitsi akatengeswa mushure meKurume 2026 ine Innioasis OS 3.0.7 isati yaiswa.

Kupenya kuvaka kwechikuru pamidziyo iyi kunodzivirira kubhowa.

Une chokwadi chekuti unoda kuratidza yekare Rockbox inovaka?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Ndapota sarudza .zip, .rar archive, kana scatter file (*scatter*.txt) mukati me firmware folder kuti uise firmware yako yakasarudzwa pa {target} yako.
sel_offline: Mazita epamhepo haapo pari zvino. Shandisa faira remunharaunda, kana tarisa kubatana kwako.
sel_no_release: Hapana kuburitswa kunowanikwa kune iyi software
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Multiple firmware packages kana kuparadzira mafaera akawanikwa mune iyi folda/archive. Ndapota sarudza folda kana dura rine firmware pasuru imwe chete panguva.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Kuburitswa uku kune faira rinopfuura rimwe rekuparadzira, saka Updater haigone kutaura kuti mutambi wako anoda dhizaini ipi. Mugadziri we {software} anozoda kugadzirisa yavo firmware kuburitswa kuti ibatanidze chete faira rekuparadzira.
sp_search_restart: Hapana mudziyo parizvino, uchitsvaga zvakare (kuyedza {count}). Chengetedza mutambi akadzima uye batanidza kana wakurudzirwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Faera rechokwadi harina kuwanikwa ({path}); kupenya pasina.
sp_config_missing_platform: Iyo faira yekuparadzira haizivise chikuva chayo, saka iyo console gadziriso yefaira yekusimbisa haina kuvakwa; kupenya pasina.
sp_config_missing_storage: Iyo faira yekuparadzira haitauri rudzi rwekuchengetera (EMMC/NAND/UFS), saka gadziriso yekoni yefaira yekusimbisa haina kuvakwa; kupenya pasina.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Hapana faira rechokwadi rakapihwa; kupenya pasina mumwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Hatina kukwanisa kunyora faira rekugadzirisa console; kupenya pasina faira rekusimbisa.
settings_notifications_desc: Ratidza zviziviso zvehurongwa zvechiziviso uye mhando dzekuvandudza pazasi. Off inochengeta zvese zviri mukati meapp.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Type ndiyo gadziriso yehardware yemutambi. Vatambi vemhando imwechete vanogona kuvakwa mune inodarika imwe kudzokorora - semuenzaniso Type A uye Type B - uye software inogadzirirwa imwe yacho. Tarisa chinonamirwa kumashure kwemutambi; kana isina kudoma mhando, siya yekutanga sarudzo.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Hapana shanduro dziripo dzeiyi software izvozvi.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Chengetedza app mubhara remenu mushure mekuvhara hwindo, saka iwe uchiri kuwana app uye mutambi firmware zviziviso. Kudzima: kuvhara hwindo kunosiya app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Chengetedza iyo app mutireyi system mushure mekuvhara hwindo, saka iwe uchiri kuwana app uye mutambi firmware zviziviso. Kudzima: kuvhara hwindo kunosiya app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Viga iyo online nharaunda catalog uye isa software kubva kune emuno mafaera chete.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Iwe wakapenya 360p Rockbox kuvaka. Ungade here kuisa iyo 360p Theme Pack pane ichi chishandiso izvozvi?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Batanidza Player mu USB Storage Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Ndapota bvisa USB, simba uye bhutsu muRockbox kamwe (saka inotanga mukati mayo .rockbox system forodha), wozobatanidza USB uye sarudza 'USB Storage Mode'.

Kana yakabatana, tinya Ramba kuti usarudze chero folda pane yako mutambi.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Sarudza chero folda pane yako yakabatana yekuchengetera mutambi
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yakabudirira kuiswa pane chako kifaa!
sel_only_local: Sarudza .zip kana .rar firmware package, kana folda / scatter .txt faira, yekuisa pasina Indaneti, hapana internet inodiwa. Inoshanda neyese Innioasis uye Timmkoo odhiyo inoridza.
sel_only_local_generic: Sarudza purogiramu ye firmware yemunharaunda (.zip, .rar) kana folda ine scatter file yekuisa pasina Indaneti, inoshanda nemagetsi eMediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Isa firmware kubva ku.zip kana .rar faira pane chero Innioasis kana Timmkoo audio player.
sel_offline_install_generic: Isa firmware kubva ku.zip/.rar archive kana firmware forodha pane generic MediaTek zvishandiso.
sel_update_available: Pane update kune {software} iripo kune yako {model}.
conn_offline: Hauna Indaneti. Kuisirwa kubva kuCommunity Firmware Archive hakusi kuwanikwa.
single_instance_body: Imwe kopi yakavhurika, kana ichiri kushanda kumashure. Makopi maviri aizokwikwidza kuti mutambi wacho awane USB yekubatanidza, saka iyi haizotanga.
single_instance_focus_failed: Iyo inomhanya kopi haina kupindura chikumbiro chekuratidza hwindo rayo. Inogona kunge yakabatikana kana kurembera. Kumanikidza kuiregedza kuchakanganisa chero chinhu chairi kuisa.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi yaitaridza haina kupera. Zvirege iwe, wobva watanga iyo updater zvakare.
single_instance_busy_body: Iyo inomhanya kopi kuisa software kana kutaura nemutambi, saka kuipedza iko zvino kungakanganisa izvo. Kuvhurwa uku kuchavhara; shandisa hwindo riripo kana iyo menyu bar icon kana yekuisa yapera.
toast_battery_charged: Usati washandisa izvi pamutambi wako, chaja bhatiri kweinenge awa
toast_battery_charged_device: Usati washandisa izvi pamudziyo wako, chaja bhatiri kweinenge awa
sel_notes_hint: Sarudza kuburitsa kuti uone shanduko yayo
flash_wait_desc: Gadzirisa mudziyo kutanga. Kana yakabatana asi isina kuonekwa, edza imwe USB tambo kana chiteshi.
dialog_pre_install_header: Ndokumbira uve nechokwadi chekuti {model} yako yakadzimwa uye haina kubatana ne USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Kudzima zvachose mudziyo wako usati watanga.
• Kana mudziyo wakaoma nechando kana ukasadaira, shandisa pini kana paperclip mugomba reset kuti umanikidzire kudzima mumodhi yekudhawunirodha.
• Chengetedza tambo yeUSB yakabviswa ikozvino.
• Tinya Ramba, wozobatanidza mudziyo wako ne USB kana waudzwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Kudzima zvachose mudziyo wako weMediaTek.
• Chengetedza tambo yeUSB yakabviswa ikozvino.
• Zvichienderana nemuenzaniso, edza kubatanidza kana usina bhatiri rakaiswa (kana kubata Volume Down / Up paunenge uchibatanidza).
• Tinya Ramba, wozobatanidza tambo ye USB kana waudzwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Hatikwanise kuchengeta data rako rekuisa uku nekuti firmware yako yazvino haienderane neKeep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Bvisa tambo ye USB uye shandisa paperclip kana pini kudzvanya bhatani reset, woedza kubatanidza zvakare.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Zvinokurudzirwa kubatanidza mutambi kumadziro emadziro kwemaminetsi makumi matatu kusvika awa asati aedza kubatanidza.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Kana uri paWindows, iva nechokwadi chokuti Makaisa maDriver.
install_first_which_firmware: Ndeipi software iri kushanda pane yako {model}?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Kana usina chokwadi, sarudza 'Zvimwe' kana software yaunofunga kuti yakaiswa.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kuti uenderere mberi neiyi yekuisa, ndapota simbisa kana yako {model} yave kutomhanyisa inodiwa base software ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Isu tinokwanisa chete kuchengeta marongero ako uye midhiya kana mutambi ave kutoshandisa iyi software kana shanduro inoenderana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Tinogona chete kuchengeta zvigadziriso zvako kana mutambi ave kutoshandisa iyi software kana shanduro inoenderana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Isu tinokwanisa chete kuchengeta marongero ako uye midhiya kana mutambi ave kutoshandisa iyi software kana shanduro inoenderana.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Bvumira Chengeta Zvirongwa uye Midhiya pane chero firmware yekuisa
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Anodarika mubvunzo wekuenderana. Shandisa izvi chete kana uine chokwadi chekuti mutambi acharamba achishanda neazvino marongero uye midhiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Haikwanise kuchengeta zvigadziriso zvako uye midhiya: iyo firmware folda hainyorwe. Hapana chakaiswa.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Inochengeta marongero ako uye midhiya pane mutambi. Mamwe masoftware anoiswa semazuva ese.
flash_keep_data_warning: Kana ukaramba usina izvi, zvigadziriso zvako uye midhiya zvichaiswa patsva pane yemukati yekuchengetedza yemutambi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Kana ukaramba usina izvi, yako Rockbox themes, mafonti uye marongero anobviswa. Mumhanzi wako uye mamwe midhiya zvinogara pane mutambi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Kana iwe ukaramba usina izvi, yako Rockbox themes, mafonti uye zvigadziriso zvichabviswa, uye chengetedzo yemukati yemutambi ichagadziridzwa.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Kana ukaramba usina izvi, marongero ako anozosetwa patsva. Mumhanzi wako uye mamwe midhiya zvinogara pane mutambi.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Iyi firmware inofanirwa kushandura chengetedzo yemukati yemutambi. Zvirongwa zvakachengetwa zvichadzimwa; mimhanzi yako uye mamwe midhiya acharamba ari munzvimbo.
format_all_data_warning_other: Iyi firmware inofanirwa kushandura chengetedzo yemukati yemutambi. Zvirongwa zvakachengetwa uye midhiya yakachengetwa pane yakavakirwa-mukati chengetedzo ichadzimwa. Midhiya pane yako microSD inogara munzvimbo.
format_all_confirm_body:
Nezve {software} tinoda kugadziridza {model} yako yekuchengetedza mukati tisati taenderera mberi. Ipapo kumwe kuedza kweSP Flash Tool kuchaedzwa, asi muFomati Yese + Dhawunirodha modhi kuburikidza neXML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Bvisa USB, wobva waisa paperclip kana pini mune reset pinhole pane yako {model}. Dzvanya Next kuti uedze zvakare muFomati Yese + Dhawunirodha modhi.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yakashuma kuti tafura yekugovera yemutambi yakachinja (8502). Iyi firmware inofanirwa kuiswa muFomati Yese + Dhawunirodha modhi, iyo inogadzirisa kuchengetedza kwemukati.
install_first_hint: Usati wamisa {target} kekutanga, {model} yako inoda kunge ichimhanya {software} - kana {target} pachayo, kana yakatoiswa uye ichishanda.
install_first_power_on_fmt: Ndokumbira ubvise USB, simba pane yako {model} uye tinya Next.
install_first_power_on_hint: Rega mutambi atange kamwe pane base firmware, wobva waidzima kune inotevera yekuisa.
install_first_need_body: {software} ndiyo yekutanga firmware ye {target}. Ichaiswa pane yako {model} kutanga, uye {target} inozotevera otomatiki. Chengetedza mutambi akabatana uye usaisunungure.
install_first_when_body: {target} haifanirwe kuiswa yakananga pamusoro {running}: pane yako {model} mutambi haazotangi zvakanaka mushure. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo nzira yakachengeteka, uye {target} yozotevera otomatiki. Chengetedza mutambi akabatana uye usarudzure.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} haifanirwe kuiswa yakananga pamusoro pesoftware yatove pane yako {model}: mutambi haazotanga zvakanaka mushure. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo nzira yakachengeteka, uye {target} yozotevera otomatiki. Chengetedza mutambi akabatana uye usarudzure.
install_first_recommend_body: Yako {model} iri kushanda {running}. Kuisa {target} pamusoro payo kunogona kuchengeta {running}'s yekutanga logo nemalogo echishandiso chetsika. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo nzira yakachena: {target} yozotevera otomatiki. Hongu inoisa {software} kutanga; Hapana kuiswa {target} ikozvino ine zvigadziriso zvitsva uye midhiya.
install_first_missing: Iyi firmware inoda {software} kutanga, asi iyo catalog haina kuisirwa kuburitswa kwe {software}.
install_first_version_unavailable: Iyi firmware inoda {software} {version}, asi hapana kuburitswa mukatalogi kunoenderana nezvinodiwa.
install_first_needs_answer: Iyi firmware inoda base firmware cheki, inoda inopindirana terminal.
keep_data_microsd_reassurance: Midhiya yako pamicroSD yako inogara iri munzvimbo
keep_data_erase_prompt_y1: Isa uye dzima marongero pane yako {model}?
keep_data_erase_prompt_other: Isa uye dzima marongero uye midhiya pane yekuchengetedza yemukati pane yako {model}?
keep_data_erase_explainer_y1: Zvirongwa zvichagadziriswazve, asi mimhanzi uye mafaera ari pamicroSD kadhi rako anozochengetwa. Edza zvakadaro
keep_data_erase_explainer_other: Zvirongwa uye zvemukati zvekuchengetera midhiya zvichagadziriswazve, asi midhiya iri pamicroSD kadhi yako ichachengetwa. Edza zvakadaro
flash_keep_data_unavailable: Iyi yekuisa ichagadzirisa zvakare marongero ako uye midhiya pane yemukati yekuchengetedza yemutambi.
flash_keep_data_unavailable_y1: Iyi yekuisa ichagadzirisa zvigadziriso zvako. Mumhanzi wako uye mamwe midhiya zvinogara pane mutambi.
flash_power_off_only_fmt: Ndokumbirawo udzime {model} yako, wobva wadzvanya Next.
flash_connect_prompt: Ndokumbira uve nechokwadi chekuti {model} yako yakadzimwa uye yakabviswa - wobva wadzvanya Next.
flash_connect_prompt_power: Ndokumbira uve nechokwadi chekuti {model} yako yakadzimwa uye yakabviswa - wobva wadzvanya Next.
flash_connect_prompt_mtk: Ndokumbira uve nechokwadi chekuti {model} yako yakabatana ne USB - wobva wadzvanya Next.
flash_connect_paperclip_prompt: Zano: Dzima mudziyo nekudzvanya bhatani rakavigwa padivi pehedhifoni jack nepaperclip kana pini.
flash_connect_paperclip_prompt_a5: Zano: Dzima A5 yako nekudzvanya bhatani rakavigwa padivi pebhatani remagetsi neklip uchishandisa paperclip kana pini.
flash_connect_failed_hint: {model} haisi kubatana? Edza izvi: Bvisa USB, shandisa paperclip kana pini kudzvanya bhatani reset, wozobatanidza tambo ye USB zvakare.
flash_paperclip_hint: Unogona kudzima zvachose {model} nekudzvanya bhatani rakavanzwa pakati pehedhifoni ne USB ports uchishandisa paperclip kana pini.
flash_paperclip_hint_a5: Unogona kudzima zvachose A5 yako nekudzvanya bhatani rakavanzika padivi pebhatani remagetsi neklip uchishandisa paperclip kana pini.
flash_paperclip_driver_hint: Kana iyo isati yabatana, ungangoda kuisa iyo {link}.
flash_y1_preloader_hint: Zano: Dzima nekudzvanya bhatani rakavigwa padivi pehedhifoni jack nepaperclip kana pini. Batanidza USB kazhinji pasina kubata mabhatani.
gui_handoff_hint_headphone: Dzima nekuisa pini kana paperclip mugomba padyo nehedhifoni port, wozobatanidza USB kana mudziyo wedesktop wakamirira.
gui_handoff_hint_a5: Isa pini kana paperclip mugomba riri pasi pebhatani remagetsi, wozobatanidza USB kana mudziyo wedesktop wakamirira.
gui_handoff_hint_generic: Simba mutambi, bvisa USB, uye ubatanidze kana chishandiso chabvunza.

support_story_1_headline: Kana vagadziri vachienderera mberi, nharaunda inosimuka.
support_story_1_lead: Chengetedza mudziyo wako kubva kune chinyararire misungo yehardware uye yakatyoka kudzokorora.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis inogara ichiburitsa nyowani nyowani firmwares yevatambi vakaita seY1 (yakananga yakavanzika bhodhi revhesheni senge 6.0, 7.0, uye 8.0) iyo chinyararire kutyora zvishandiso zvekare. Zvakatonyanya, webhusaiti yavo inopa zero yambiro uye zero kuwana kune yapfuura kushanda firmwares kuti udzoke kubva kune zvidhinha. Updater CE uye Community Firmware purojekiti inotora zvimedu: isu tinochengeta nhaka yega yega stock ROM, otomatiki ongorora yako hardware, uye chengetedza mutambi wako achimhanya zvakachengeteka.
support_story_1_item_1: Kununura Vatambi Vakaputsika: Cheki dzekuchengetedza dzinoona kuti zvigadziriso zvitsva hazvimbofi zvidhinha zvekare.
support_story_1_item_2: Yakachengetwa Stock ROMs: Yakazara muunganidzwa wemafekitori firmwares Innioasis yakabviswa.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Yakazara inopenya maturusi eMacOS, Linux, uye Windows zvakafanana.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Otomatiki bhodhi yekuona saka iwe unogara uchiwana iyo chaiyo package.
support_story_2_headline: Hapana maGoogle Drives akatyoka. Hapana kufungidzira-basa. Kungoshanda firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Yepamusoro-kumhanya, yakasimbiswa nharaunda zvivakwa zvaunogona kunyatso kuvimba nazvo.
support_story_2_body: Kuronda zviri pamutemo Innioasis software kunowanzoreva kupenengura maforamu eakapera nguva Google Drive link, akafa Baidu gore masheya, uye zvakavanzika zip mafaera asina anopenya maturusi. Isu takavaka yakavimbika, yakazvimirira yekurodha network ine yakasimbiswa SHA-256 kutendeseka, zviziviso zvekuvandudza, uye nhanho-ne-nhanho inotungamirwa kuisirwa. Mipiro yako inochengeta zvakananga kurodha uye kubata izvo zvinoita kuti izvi zvigoneke maawa makumi maviri nemana pazuva, mazuva 365 pagore.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Inokurumidza, yakananga kurodha pasina miganho yekudhawunirodha kana akafa zvinongedzo.
support_story_2_item_2: Gadziridza Zviziviso: Yambiro panguva iyo nharaunda itsva inoburitswa kana kugadzirisa kunodonha.

support_story_2_item_4: Nharaunda Yemitauro Yakawanda: Yakazara munharaunda muChirungu, Chinese, Germany, Spanish, French & Japanese.
support_story_3_headline: Kuvhura iyo yakazara mukana weInnioasis player yako.
support_story_3_lead: Kuunza Rockbox, tsika yakareruka inoshanda masisitimu, uye audiophile rusununguko.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory software inongokweva pamusoro pezvingaitwa neY1 yako kana Y2 hardware. Nharaunda yedu yakaunza Rockbox, lightweight custom operating systems, audiophile codec playback, uye tsika tema kuhupenyu. Isu tinotenga zvinhu zvakasiyana-siyana zve Hardware kunze-kwe-homwe kuti tiedze, dzosera mainjiniya, uye nekuona yega yega yekuisirwa. Kutsigira Kugadziridza CE mari yakananga aya mayuniti ekuyedza uye inomhanyisa tsika firmware kusimudzira.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile yekutamba uye tsika madingindira akaiswa mumasekondi.
support_story_3_item_2: Nharaunda Firmware: Mabhatiri ekuwedzera, yekuchenesa UI, uye yemazuva ano audio codec rutsigiro.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Isu tinoedza pamidziyo chaiyo yemuviri tisati taburitsa chero kuvaka.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yemahara, yakavanzika-yekutanga software isina ads kana yekutevera.
support_story_4_lead: Community-powered firmware kuchengetedza inochengeta zvishandiso zvako kunze kwemarara.
support_story_4_body: Kana kambani yehardware ichienda kune yavo inotevera gadget, mamodheru ekare anosiiwa. Innioasis inopa hapana Linux tsigiro, hapana yakajeka shanduko, uye hapana nzira iri nyore yekupora kana yekuisa yatadza. Updater CE iripo nekuti vashandisi vane shungu havafanire kurasa inoridza mimhanzi yakanaka. 100% yezvipo munharaunda inoenda zvakananga mukuchengeta chishandiso ichi chakavhurika kune wese munhu.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Yakaratidza kupora inoyerera kunyangwe michina ichiramba kubhoti.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Chekutanga-Kirasi Tsigiro: Inotsigirwa zvizere MediaTek inopenya paLinux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Yakadzama kuburitsa manotsi kuti iwe uzive chaizvo shanduko.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Nharaunda Inopihwa Mari: Yese kofi inochengeta dura rakavhurika uye mahara kune vese.

   (Unogona kushandisa pini kana paperclip kudzvanya bhatani reset kana zvichidikanwa)

2. Kana yakabatana, bvisa tambo ye USB kubva pa {label} yako.

Wobva wadzvanya OK uye tevera mirairo iri pa-screen.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Kana isati yadzima, dzima {label} yako.
• Kana yakabatana neUSB, bvisa iyo kutanga.
• MuSP Flash Tool, tinya Dhawunirodha.

Zvadaro batanidza USB tambo kuti utange kupenya.
sel_type_help_body:
Edza Type A System Software kutanga.

Kana vhiri rako remupumburu rikasapindura mushure mekuiswa, isa imwe yemhando yeType B sarudzo.

Type B zvishandiso ndeizvo zvakauya neshanduro dze firmware kare pane 2.0.
sel_install_tooltip_generic: Isa yakasarudzwa system software pane chako kifaa
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool yakaiswa pamwe ne libpng12 kuenderana.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Dzvanya-tarisa zvakare kana tangazve kuseta kuti udhawunirodhe package.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Mitemo yeMediaTek inoshanda (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Desktop access yakagoneswa.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Ipa mvumo kamwe chete kuti app igone kutaurirana nemudziyo wako.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Mvumo ye USB & udev mitemo yakaiswa zvinobudirira. Masevhisi akagadziridzwa.
donate_rely_on_you: Tibatsirei nemari yedu yekumhanya, mupe nhasi.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vhura MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: App inogadzirisa zvachose kune defaults, kurodha cache yakacheneswa, uye bhatiri chiyeuchidzo chadzoreredzwa.
log_app_reset_defaults: Kugadziriswa kweApp kudzoreredzwa zvachose kune defaults, kurodha cache yakacheneswa, uye bhatiri chiyeuchidzo chadzoreredzwa (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Ramba wakavharirwa mukati, Rockbox iri kutanga uye madingindira ayo anozowedzerwa otomatiki.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Tarisa kuti yabairwa here uye yabatidzwa. Kana ikaramba yakasviba, dzvanya pini mugomba reset uye bata bhatani repakati (Y1) kana bhatani remagetsi (vamwe vatambi) kuti utangezve. Kana iyo isati yatanga, iyo firmware haina kutora, isa imwe.
action_flash_complete: Flash yakakwana! Bvisa USB uye reboot.
action_recover_powercycle: Simba-kutenderera mutambi (bata simba ~ 10s), wozoibatanidza zvakare - kuedza zvakare...
action_wait_mtk: Yakamirira MTK mudziyo... Dzima mudziyo uye ubatanidze USB.
action_da_stall: Mudziyo wakamira kudaira uchiri kugadziridza mumiririri wekudhawunirodha. Idzima zvachose, batanidza, uye edzazve.
action_detected_brom: Chishandiso chaonekwa (BROM modhi) - gadziriso yekurodha mumiririri...
action_detected_preloader: Chishandiso chaonekwa (preloader modhi) - gadziriso yekurodha mumiririri...
action_da_wait_back: Mutambi akamira kudaira achitanga download agent. Ndakamirira kuti idzoke...
log_install_writing: Isa muKufambira mberi - kunyora firmware mifananidzo...
log_sparse_fmt: Yaonekwa Android sparse mufananidzo we {part}, uchishandura-mukuita...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kuongororwa kwetafura yezvikamu kwakundikana mushure mekunyora
err_sp_wrong_model: Wabatanidza mhando isiriyo yemutambi. Dzvanya bhatani rekuti × kudzima iyi, wosarudza software yemutambi wawakabatanidza.
err_sp_timeout: Chombo haana kumboona mutambi. Ichengete yakadzimwa uye isina plug, wozobatanidza tambo ye USB kana wakurudzirwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mutambi akakurumidza kumuka. Idzima zvachose, wozoibatanidza zvakare.
err_sp_download_fail: Kunyora kwakadzongonyedzwa. Tarisa tambo ye USB uye chiteshi uye bhatiri kuchaja, woedza zvakare.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Mumiriri wekudhaunirodha haana kukwanisa kutanga. Edza imwe nzira yekupenya.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Mumiririri wedhaunirodha haana kutumirwa kumutambi. Idzima wobatanidzazve.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Mutambi akaramba mumiriri wekudhawunirodha ( kukanganisa 6104). Shandisa Dhawunirodha Agent yakaunganidzwa neSP Flash Tool, uye tarisa kuti firmware inofanana nemutambi uyu.
err_sp_com_port: Chishandiso hachina kukwanisa kuvhura serial port yayo. Vhara zvimwe zvishandiso zvinopenya uye batanidza zvakare.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Iyo USB COM port haina kukwanisa kuvhurwa (kukanganisa 1013). Kutangazve komputa yako kunoburitsa chiteshi chakakiiwa. Ndapota tangazve komputa yako uye edza zvakare.
err_sp_enable_dram: Chishandiso hachina kukwanisa kutanga ndangariro yemutambi. Shandisa pasuru yakavakirwa iyi chaiyo modhi.
err_sp_storage_read: Chishandiso hachina kukwanisa kuverenga chengetedzo yemutambi. Tarisa kubatana; mudziyo unogona kunge uine chikanganiso chehardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Chishandiso chinopenya chakaratidza kusafambira mberi mukati {seconds} masekonzi, saka kuedza uku kwakamiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Hatina kukwanisa kubatanidza nemutambi. Ita shuwa kuti mudziyo wakadzimwa (shandisa pini kudzvanya bhatani reseta kana zvichidikanwa), buditsa USB, uye ubatanidzezve kana wakurudzirwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kupenya kwavhiringwa kana kuti kunyora kwatadza. Tarisa kuti tambo ye USB yakanyatsobatanidzwa uye bhatiri rine mari yakakwana, woedza zvakare.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Chishandiso chinopenya chakaratidza mutsara wakafanana wekupedzisira {seconds} masekondi uye hachiratidzike kuenderera mberi nekunyora firmware. Kupenya kungave kwatadza. Kana iyi yaive yekupedzisira yekuedza kuviri nenzira yega yega pane system inogona kuwira kumashure pakati pavo, kana kana chete MTKClient iripo pamushini uyu, tangazve komputa uye edza zvakare.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Chete MTKClient inowanikwa kune iyi yekuisa. Kupenya kungave kwatadza. Ndapota tangazve komputa uye edza zvakare.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Komputa iyi inogonawo kuisa uchishandisa SP Flash Tool. Kana uchikwanisa, chinja kuSP Flash Tool woedza zvakare.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Kupenya kungave kwatadza. Ndapota verenga meseji iri pamusoro uye wotangazve komputa usati waedza zvakare. Kana iwe ukadzvanya OK, iyo app inomira kuti utangezve.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iyo firmware package irikushaikwa iyo yekuparadzira faira kana inodiwa mafaira emifananidzo. Ndapota dhawunirodha pasuru yacho kana sarudza yakazara firmware file.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Iro faira rechokwadi rawakasarudza haripo, harina chinhu kana kuti harina kunyorwa. Sarudza faira rinoshanda, kana kuti rijekese muZvirongwa, wobva wapenya zvakare.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Chishandiso chinopenya kana madhiraivha ehurongwa anodiwa haana kukwanisa kutangwa. Ndokumbira utarise mvumo yesystem, kuseta mutyairi, kana kumisazve application.
err_driver_missing_desc: Iko kukanganisa kunogona kuitika kana MediaTek USB mutyairi asina kuiswa. Dzvanya Dhawunirodha Madhiraivha kuti uise MediaTek USB mutyairi, tangazve komputa yako, uye edza zvakare.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: A cached firmware file haipo. Sarudza Sarudza Software kuti uvake zvakare mafaera akabviswa kana kurodha firmware archive zvakare. Iri idambudziko refaira remunharaunda, kwete nyaya yekubatanidza USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Dzokera kuSarudza Software kuti uvakezve kana kurodha firmware package.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Sarudza firmware yekuburitsa kuti utore zvakare.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Chikanganiso chisingatarisirwi chakaitika panguva yekuisa ({detail}). Dzima mutambi zvachose, batanidza kana wakurudzirwa, uye edza zvakare.
flash_method_confirm: Kuisa nzira yakashandurwa kuita {method}. Simbisa kuti mutambi wacho haana plug uye akadzima, wobva wadzvanya Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} haina kuita kuti kuiswa kwacho kutange. Mushure mekunge mutambi adzimwa uye kuburitswa, {other} ichashandiswa pachinzvimbo.
themepack_card_desc: Inosanganisira madingindira akanaka enharaunda, zvigadziriso zvekumashure, uye mafonti akagadzirirwa 360p kuratidza.
themepack_step1_title: Danho 1: Batanidza mu USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Batidza mutambi wako nekubata bhatani reSimba.
2. Kana Rockbox majombo, plug USB tambo kupinda kombiyuta yako.
3. Kana ukakurudzirwa pachiratidziro chevatambi, simbisa USB Storage mode kuti mudziyo uoneke sekutyaira.
themepack_step2_desc: Nekuti masisitimu anoshanda (akadai semacOS) anovanza dotfiles (senge .rockbox) nekusarudzika, unogona kusarudza CHESE folda kana dhiraivha mudzi pane mutambi wako. Tichazvitsvakira kana kugadzira dhairekitori re .rockbox rako.
themepack_complete: Theme pack yakaiswa zvinobudirira! Iwe unogona ikozvino kubvisa zvakachengeteka mutambi wako uye sarudza dingindira muRockbox (Settings> Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Hatina kukwanisa kuwana kana kutanga .rockbox directory padhiraivha yakasarudzwa. Ndokumbira utarise kuti wasarudza folda pane mutambi wako.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Danho 1: Tangazve mutambi uye batanidza zvakare
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Bvisa tambo ye USB.
2. Simba mutambi shure uye regai itange kupinda Rockbox.
3. Kamwe Rockbox iri kushanda, batanidza tambo ye USB, wobva wadzvanya Ramba.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Danho rechipiri: Kutsvaga mutambi pamusoro peADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Iyo app iri kutarisa yekubatanidza ADB (kusvika masekondi makumi matatu). Kana mudziyo ukawanikwa, madingindira anotamiswa uye mutambi anodzoserwa otomatiki. Zvikasadaro, svetuka kumberi ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kumirira mudziyo weADB... (kusvika kumasekonzi makumi matatu)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Hapana ADB mudziyo waonekwa mukati 30 masekonzi; kuenderera mberi ne USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Hapana ADB binary inowanikwa kune iyo app; kuenderera mberi ne USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kusundira misoro uye mafonti pamusoro peADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB kutapurirana kwakundikana; inowira kumashure ku USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Isa kuburikidza ne USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Gonesa USB Storage Mode pane mutambi kuti iite sekutyaira.
2. Sarudza CHESE folda pane mutambi ari pazasi (.rockbox, Music, Themes, kana dhiraivha mudzi, yakavanzika .rockbox forodha inowanikwa otomatiki).
3. Iyo app inobatanidza 360p madingindira nemafonti mukati, ichinyora pamusoro pemazita mamwechete mafaira.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Iwe unogona ikozvino kubvisa zvakachengeteka mutambi uye sarudza dingindira muRockbox (Settings> Theme Settings).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software yako itsva yakaiswa, asi .rockbox folda yekare haina kubviswa. Delete the .rockbox forodha pane mutambi noruoko kana uchida kwakachena kutanga.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Anopfuura mutambi mumwe akabatana. Bvisa mamwe uye siya imwe chete iri kuiswa.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Mutambi aonekwa. Kuisa madingindira enharaunda & mafonti...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Bata bhatani repakati kuti usimbise paY1 yako, batanidza USB, uye sarudza USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Bata bhatani remagetsi kuti uise simba pane mutambi wako, batanidza USB, uye sarudza USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Mudziyo hausi kutanga? Dzosa software yekutanga
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Ndokumbirawo ubvise uye simba pane yako {model}, wobva wadzvanya Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Bvisa USB, bata iyo {button} kusimba pane yako {model}, wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Ndokumbirawo gonesa USB modhi yekuchengetera pane chako kifaa uye tinya Next
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Ndokumbirawo gonesa USB modhi yekuchengetera pane yako {model}, wobva wasarudza drive inoratidzika
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Ndapota sarudza mutambi wacho kana rimwe remaforodha ari pairi
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Bvisa iyo USB uye simba paY1 yako, wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Bvisa USB uye simba pane yako {model}, wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Sarudza 'USB Storage Mode' pane mutambi wako.
2. Dzvanya 'Browse Folder...' kusarudza mutambi wako uye kuisa madingindira.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Iyi Rockbox kuvaka inoshandisa 240 × 320 themes, iyo isina kuunganidzwa. Tora matema emahara emutambi wako kubva paRockbox theme saiti:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Kana {model} yako ikasabhuti, bvisa USB, bata bhatani remagetsi kuti 10s igadzirise, uye batidza. Kana kudzoreredza software yekutanga.
err_storage_full_desc: Komputa yako yapererwa nenzvimbo yekuchengetera. Ndapota sunungura nzvimbo yedhisiki padhiraivha yako uye edza zvakare.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Iyo yekare vhezheni yeUpdater ichiri pakombuta iyi uye inotora nzvimbo yedhisiki. Kuibvisa kunosunungura nzvimbo iyoyo.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Bvisa yekare Innioasis Updater application uye maforodha ekutsigira
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Chengetedza Android Platform Zvishandiso (ADB / Fastboot) yakaiswa
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Kana iwe usingashandisi ADB kana Fastboot kunze kweUpdater CE, bvisa kusunungura uye kutorazve kumwe kuchengetedza.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Zvakabudirira kuchenesa kuisirwa nhaka uye kudzoreredza dhisiki nzvimbo.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Imwe shanduro yekare yeUpdater ichiri pakombiyuta iyi. Kuibvisa kunosunungura dhisiki nzvimbo.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Izvi zvinobvisa zvachose app yekare, kurodha firmware, uye mafaera akasara.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Bvisa iyo Android Platform Zvishandiso (ADB / Fastboot) futi? Sarudza Chengeta kana ukashandisa ADB.
log_btn_save_file_tip: Tumira kunze faira regi rakaratidzwa kune dhisiki
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Windows rutsigiro haina kuedzwa. PaSnapdragon uye RTX Spark laptops, Zadig inogona kushandiswa neDriver Signature Enforcement yakaremara kuisa WinUSB kana libusb yeMT6227 Preloader mudziyo muMutariri weChishandiso. Ona iyo ARM64 mutyairi gwara pamatanho.
keep_data_which_firmware_fmt: Ndeipi software iri kushanda pane yako {model}?
